about: The one source of PSA Small Area Estimate rounds and the default years of a data run (audit M5). Read by pipeline/lgu/rounds.py (Python), crates/lgu-core/build.rs (Rust, at build time) and web/scripts/gen-rounds.mjs (web/src/lib/rounds.gen.ts). The panel's feature years are not set here: they come from the feature store. A new round: add it here, add its workbook parser to pipeline/lgu/labels.py if the layout is new, and run a data version.
